title: Poor quality materials, shoddy construction and badly prepped. Falling apart
text:
Poor quality materials, shoddy construction and badly prepped. Falling apart. What an unpleasant experience and disappointment. This cabinet is not prepared properly to survive a cross country trip in a truck at all. It arrived beaten to a pulp and almost unusable for its intended purpose. There are two reasons for this. Poor quality of materials used in construction and zero consideration given to packing it. At this mid three figure price point, that is inexcusable

The back of the cabinet was completely off and all the screws were stripped, loose in the box. The inside of the back was splintered where the plywood had been damaged - plywood. Really? The front edge corners are all battered into broken bits with the enamel veneer peeling off. The front left door had the top hinge completely broken off and looking closely, the top hole was never actually drilled. Which means that the hinge was never fully attached at the factory to begin with! That door simply doesn't close and the inside rail is splintered and cracked anyway.

The grey finish is pretty and the size overall is good - it also could be a very nice looking cabinet in a dining room or study. There's enough room inside to repurpose it for any number of uses beyond liquor bottles. However, I would think twice about the (lack of) quality and care taken in making this piece and getting it to you.
